notes: The pleonastic הִוא before the repeated הָעֹלָה is marked unrepresented under rule 22; the ASV writes the noun phrase once for each Hebrew occurrence and nothing for the pronoun.
The marginal reading on its firewood does not affect the segmentation of מוֹקְדָה.
Both construct chains with an arthrous rectum are counted by rule 29: the article takes the the standing before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one.
